title: Attention Is All You Need
summary:
the dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder . we propose a new simple network architecture , the Transformer , based solely on attention mechanisms , dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely . 
 experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train .
key_findings: Introduced the Transformer architecture based solely on attention mechanisms.
Demonstrated superior performance in machine translation tasks compared to traditional models.
Achieved significant reductions in training time and increased parallelization.
methodology: The study employed a novel architecture called the Transformer, which relies entirely on attention mechanisms without using recurrence or convolutions.
limitations: The model's performance on tasks outside of machine translation is not evaluated.
Potential overfitting issues in smaller datasets were not addressed.
future_work: Exploring the application of the Transformer architecture to other NLP tasks.
Investigating methods to further reduce training time and improve efficiency.
Enhancing the model's robustness against overfitting in various datasets.
